name: vias-data-centers
description: Site institucional VIAS DATA CENTERS — React + Three.js + Motion (frontend) e NestJS (backend).

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,blue "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w frontend && npm run build -w backend
scripts.prod: npm run build && npm run start
